afterVisibleChange.zh-CN: 面板显示时在 `visible` 变为 `true` 的那次提交中立即触发，不等进场动画；隐藏时在离场动画结束后触发；显示期间被卸载，或所在子树被 `Activity` 隐藏时以 `false` 触发一次。
afterVisibleChange.en-US: Called in the commit where `visible` becomes `true`, without waiting for the enter animation. When hiding, called after the leave animation ends; also called once with `false` when unmounted while shown, or when its subtree is hidden by `Activity`.

aria-label.zh-CN: 对话框的可访问名称，传入后覆盖由 `title` 生成的名称。
aria-label.en-US: Accessible name of the dialog. When set, it takes the place of the name generated from `title`.

bodyStyle.zh-CN: 内容区域的样式，类型为 `CSSProperties`，键使用 camelCase，如 `borderBottom`。
bodyStyle.en-US: Style of the content area, a `CSSProperties` object with camelCase keys such as `borderBottom`.

canVerticalSetWidth.zh-CN: `placement` 为 `top`、`bottom` 时 `width` 是否生效；默认这两种位置横向铺满。
canVerticalSetWidth.en-US: Whether `width` applies when `placement` is `top` or `bottom`. By default those sheets span the full width.

children.zh-CN: 面板内容，渲染在 `.semi-sidesheet-body` 中。
children.en-US: Content of the sheet, rendered in `.semi-sidesheet-body`.

className.zh-CN: 根元素的类名，根元素是 portal 内最外层的 `.semi-sidesheet` 元素。
className.en-US: Class name of the root element, the outermost `.semi-sidesheet` element inside the portal.

closable.zh-CN: 是否显示右上角的关闭按钮。
closable.en-US: Whether the close button in the top right corner is shown.

closeIcon.zh-CN: 关闭按钮中的图标；传入 `null` 或 `undefined` 时使用默认图标，隐藏关闭按钮请用 `closable={false}`。
closeIcon.en-US: Icon inside the close button. `null` or `undefined` falls back to the default icon; hide the button with `closable={false}`.

closeOnEsc.zh-CN: 是否允许按 `Esc` 关闭面板。

disableScroll.zh-CN: 带遮罩且渲染在 `document.body` 中时，打开期间是否禁止 body 滚动，即给 body 添加 `overflow: hidden`。
disableScroll.en-US: Whether body scrolling is locked (`overflow: hidden` on body) while a masked sheet is rendered in `document.body`.

footer.zh-CN: 面板底部的内容；内容为空时不渲染底部。
footer.en-US: Footer of the sheet. Nothing is rendered when it is empty.

getPopupContainer.zh-CN: 指定弹层渲染到的父级 DOM，不传入时渲染到 `document.body`。自定义容器需要设置 `position: relative`；这会改变浮层的 DOM 位置，不改变视图位置。
getPopupContainer.en-US: Parent element the sheet is rendered into. When omitted, it is rendered in `document.body`. A custom container needs `position: relative`; this changes where the sheet sits in the DOM, not where it is shown.

headerStyle.zh-CN: 面板头部的样式，类型同 `bodyStyle`。
headerStyle.en-US: Style of the header, of the same type as `bodyStyle`.

height.zh-CN: 高度，`placement` 为 `top` 或 `bottom` 时生效；数字按像素处理，字符串为合法 CSS 长度。未设置时为 448。
height.en-US: Height, used when `placement` is `top` or `bottom`. A number is in pixels; a string is any valid CSS length. 448 when omitted.

keepDOM.zh-CN: 关闭时是否保留面板内部节点而不销毁。
keepDOM.en-US: Whether the sheet content stays mounted while closed.

mask.zh-CN: 是否显示遮罩；为 `false` 时外部区域可以操作，且不锁定 body 滚动。
mask.en-US: Whether the mask is shown. When `false`, the content outside stays operable and body scrolling is not locked.

maskClosable.zh-CN: 是否允许点击遮罩关闭面板。
maskClosable.en-US: Whether clicking the mask closes the sheet.

maskStyle.en-US: Style of the mask, of the same type as `bodyStyle`.

onCancel.zh-CN: 用户通过关闭按钮、遮罩或 `Esc` 关闭面板时调用，参数为原生 `MouseEvent`，按 `Esc` 时为原生 `KeyboardEvent`。面板不会自行关闭，需要在回调中把 `visible` 设为 `false`。
onCancel.en-US: Called when the user closes the sheet with the close button, the mask or `Esc`. The argument is the native `MouseEvent`, or the native `KeyboardEvent` for `Esc`. The sheet does not close by itself; set `visible` to `false` in the callback.

placement.zh-CN: 面板滑出的位置，可选 `top`、`bottom`、`left` 或 `right`。
placement.en-US: Edge the sheet slides in from: `top`, `bottom`, `left` or `right`.

ref.zh-CN: 根元素（portal 内最外层的 `.semi-sidesheet` 元素）的引用；面板未渲染时为 `null`。
ref.en-US: Reference to the root element, the outermost `.semi-sidesheet` element inside the portal. It is `null` while nothing is rendered.

size.zh-CN: 尺寸，可选 `small`（448px）、`medium`（684px）或 `large`（920px），仅 `placement` 为 `left` 或 `right` 时生效；设置了 `width` 时以 `width` 为准。
size.en-US: Size: `small` (448px), `medium` (684px) or `large` (920px). Used only when `placement` is `left` or `right`; `width` takes precedence when set.

style.zh-CN: 对话框元素（`.semi-sidesheet-inner`）的样式，与组件计算出的宽高合并，计算出的宽高优先。
style.en-US: Style of the dialog element (`.semi-sidesheet-inner`), merged with the computed width and height, which take precedence.

title.zh-CN: 面板标题；内容为空时不渲染标题，并作为对话框的可访问名称。
title.en-US: Title of the sheet. Nothing is rendered when it is empty, and it names the dialog.

visible.zh-CN: 面板是否可见，受控属性；关闭时需在 `onCancel` 中同步设为 `false`。
visible.en-US: Whether the sheet is visible. A controlled prop: set it to `false` in `onCancel` to close the sheet.

width.zh-CN: 宽度，`placement` 为 `left` 或 `right` 时生效（`canVerticalSetWidth` 为 `true` 时 `top`、`bottom` 也生效）；数字按像素处理，字符串为合法 CSS 长度。未设置时由 `size` 决定。
width.en-US: Width, used when `placement` is `left` or `right`, and also when `placement` is `top` or `bottom` with `canVerticalSetWidth`. A number is in pixels; a string is any valid CSS length. Decided by `size` when omitted.
